notes: Synlait Milk (NZX/ASX: SM1) — New Zealand dairy processor. Dual listed (Canterbury, NZ and ASX). Manufactures infant formula base powder for a2 Milk Company (largest customer ~50%+ revenue) and own-brand products. Fiscal year ends July 31. Three plants: Dunsandel (Canterbury), Pokeno (Waikato), Auckland (consumer-pack). Heavily indebted post Pokeno + Dairyworks expansion. Recapitalised 2024 with NZD 217.8M equity raise (Bright Dairy + a2 Milk). Reports in NZD.

periods.notes: FY20 (ended Jul 31 2020): revenue NZD 1.30B (+9%). EBITDA NZD 119M. Net income NZD 75M. Pre-Dairyworks integration.
FY21 (ended Jul 31 2021): revenue NZD 1.37B. EBITDA collapsed to NZD 6M. Net loss NZD 28M. Inventory writedowns + a2 Milk demand softness. Pokeno ramp losses.
FY22 (ended Jul 31 2022): revenue NZD 1.66B (+21%). EBITDA NZD 78M. Net income NZD 39M (recovery). Strong commodity dairy prices.
FY23 (ended Jul 31 2023): revenue NZD 1.58B (-5%). EBITDA NZD 35M. Net loss NZD 4M. China infant formula demand weak. Leverage spiked.
FY24 (ended Jul 31 2024): revenue NZD 1.66B. EBITDA NZD -134M (impairments NZD ~150M on Pokeno + North Island consumer assets). Net loss NZD 182M. Going concern noted; recap completed Sept 2024.
FY25 (ended Jul 31 2025): revenue NZD 1.69B. EBITDA recovered to NZD 95M post-recap. Net income NZD 12M. NZD 217.8M equity raise diluted shares to ~1.79bn. Bright Dairy 65%, a2 Milk ~19%.
